Assistant (3.8s): Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. We record this call. Am I speaking with Ms Hoffmann?

User (5.0s): Yes, this is Lena Hoffmann.

Assistant (10.6s): Thank you. Before we continue, I need to ask you two short security questions. What is your date of birth?

User (12.2s): It is the 29th, sorry, I mean the 30th of January 1984.

Assistant (23.0s): Thank you. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (24.8s): The last four digits are 2219.

Assistant (46.1s): Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment. Your car loan has a past-due amount of 1250.00, which is 14 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (47.7s): I cannot pay today. My salary arrives on the 5th, I mean the 6th of November and I can pay then. Am I talking to a robot?

Assistant (55.7s): I am Freya Bank's digital assistant. I acknowledge you can pay on November 6th. The latest date I can record for the car loan is Friday 23 October 2026, so can you pay 1250.00 on that day?

User (58.7s): Yes, I can pay on that day.

Assistant (66.4s): To confirm: you will pay 1250.00 for the car loan on Friday 23 October 2026. Do you confirm?

User (67.5s): Yes, I confirm.

Assistant (74.6s): Thank you, one moment please.

Assistant (100.5s): Thank you. Your promise of 1250.00 for the car loan on Friday 23 October 2026 is recorded. You will receive a text message confirming this promise. Thank you for your time, goodbye.
